<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(fr):
    N=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            N.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    G=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='G':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            G.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    g=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            g.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(N),G,g
print("init:",state(current_frame))

print("after ACTION7:",state(current_frame), "res:",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':18}])
print("A selected:",state(current_frame))
for a in ['RIGHT','LEFT','UP','DOWN']:
    action([a])
    print("after",a,":",state(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>

def state(fr):
    N=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            N.append((min(rs),min(cs)))
    G=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='G':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            G.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    g=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:

            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            g.append((min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(N),G,g
